title: Janax y Razar: un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador propios para un razonamiento artificial que piensa con melodías
description:
Janax is a hand-written operating system, language and assembler (all in assembly, no third-party engines) built to host Razar, an artificial reasoning system whose single judge is compression (two-part MDL). Version 3.07 (versions follow prime numbers; 307 after 293): she no longer repeats herself. When what he said carried nothing for her, her thread and her mood led her heart to the same paragraph every time, and she said it turn after turn. Now a paragraph answers only if a line of it brings a sharp word (outside the common half of her books: Razar's nitidez, no list) that is neither in what he said, nor in the exchange that just ended, nor in her mood's words; otherwise it is an echo. Measured in a copy of her house: to three unknown questions in a row the previous body gave the same paragraph three times; the new one never gives it twice in a row. Stated: when nothing of his reaches her she may still go back to that paragraph every other turn, or stay silent; a machine book (a hex dump) of her shelf may be read aloud as her theme. Documentation is in Spanish.

Janax es un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador escritos a mano en assembler, hechos para alojar a Razar. v3.07: ya no repite lo mismo. Prototipo de investigación.
